failedObligations.finding: ONE OF THE SEVEN STOP CONDITIONS THE REGISTRY HOLDS FOR THIS TRACK NEVER APPEARS AS A STOP, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT MARKS THE MOMENT THE PROCEEDING STOPS BEING SELF-HELP. I compared data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json trackId tx_nd_conviction_no_supervision selfHelpStopConditions against participant-instructions.md and the delivered bytes, condition by condition, grepping each condition's distinguishing terms. Carried: prior conviction or deferred adjudication other than a fine-only traffic offence; immigration; the violent-or-sexual determination under Sec. 411.0735(c-1); the Penal Code Sec. 22.01 assault carve-out; and completion of the sentence. ABSENT: 'THE PROSECUTOR OPPOSES THE PETITION OR REQUESTS A HEARING'. The words 'opposes', 'objects' and 'requests a hearing' appear 0 times in participant-instructions.md and 0 times in the delivered canonical bytes; I grepped each. The packet is not silent about the mechanism -- its filing-instructions page says 'A hearing is required UNLESS the State does not request one before the 45th day after receiving notice AND the court finds that you are entitled to file the petition and that issuing the order is in the best interest of justice' -- but describing when a hearing happens is not telling the participant that a contested hearing is where they need a lawyer, and the registry names it as exactly that. A pro se participant who reads the 45-day sentence learns to expect a hearing; nothing tells them to stop preparing to attend it alone. RECORDED ALONGSIDE, NOT SEPARATELY SCORED: the registry's first condition is 'Any family violence finding OR FAMILY VIOLENCE ALLEGATION anywhere in the record' and the packet narrows it to 'the court has made an affirmative finding of family violence'; 'allegation' appears 0 times in the md and 0 times in the delivered bytes, so a participant with an allegation and no finding is told nothing, which is precisely the ambiguous case the registry flags. '411.0735' returns 0 in both fixtures and the md; 'violent' returns 0; 'sexual in nature' returns 0.
